title: Step 3a - Scikit-learn for Multiple Linear Regression: Efficient Model Building

cues.en: -: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: I hope you're feeling fantastic now after this first data processing phase that we tackled in flashlight together.
cues.zh: 希望剛才快速完成資料前處理後，你也感到很棒。

cues.en: Now we are ready for the exciting step, which is to train the Multiple Linear Regression model on the training set that we now collected, thanks to the previous step.
cues.zh: 現在準備進入精彩步驟，在前一步取得的訓練集上，訓練多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: But first, before we do this, I would like to answer two important questions.
cues.zh: 不過，先回答兩個重要問題。

cues.en: The first question is, do we have to avoid, you know to do something to avoid the dummy variable trap?
cues.zh: 第一，需要額外做什麼，來避免虛擬變數陷阱嗎？

cues.en: And the answer is no because indeed the Multiple Linear Regression class that we're about to import and which will build the Multiple Linear Regression
cues.zh: 答案是不需要，因為即將匯入、用來建立多元線性迴歸

cues.en: model itself and actually also train it because remember that a class actually can complete several actions including building it and training it.
cues.zh: 模型的類別，也能負責訓練；別忘了，一個類別可以執行多項操作。

cues.en: And while this class will automatically avoid this trap which means that indeed, you know one of the three first columns here because remember Kyril explained
cues.zh: 這個類別會自動處理虛擬變數陷阱，也就是前三欄裡，有一欄如 Kirill 所說

cues.en: that one is redundant, well, we'll automatically be outcast.
cues.zh: 是多餘的，會在運算中受到處理。

cues.en: So you have nothing to worry about regarding the dummy variable trap, you don't have to remove one of the columns here.
cues.zh: 所以不必擔心，不需要在這裡手動刪除一欄。

cues.en: And that's the beauty of classes.
cues.zh: 這就是類別方便的地方。

cues.en: You know, these are advanced implementations that allow you to build a model, a machinery model, in just a few lines of code.
cues.zh: 這些成熟的實作，讓你用幾行程式就能建立模型。

cues.en: And this will take care of the dummy variable trap for you.
cues.zh: 也能處理虛擬變數陷阱。

cues.en: Now, second question, do we have to work on the features to select the best ones with, you know the techniques that Kyril introduced to you,
cues.zh: 第二，需要利用 Kirill 介紹的技術，選出最好的特徵嗎？

cues.en: like, for example, backward elimination.
cues.zh: 例如向後淘汰。

cues.en: Do we have to deploy the backward elimination technique in order to select the features that have the highest P values and that are the most statistically significant?
cues.zh: 要用向後淘汰，選出 p 值最高，或最具統計顯著性的特徵嗎？

cues.en: And the answer is once again, no.
cues.zh: 答案同樣是不需要。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, for the exact same reason as the dummy variable trap.
cues.zh: 和虛擬變數陷阱相同的理由。

cues.en: The class that we're about to call to build our Multiple Linear Regression model will automatically identify the best features, you know
cues.zh: 講者認為，用來建立模型的類別會自動辨識最好的特徵，

cues.en: the features that have the highest P values or that are the most statistically significant to figure out how to predict the dependent variable, you know the profit with the highest accuracy.
cues.zh: 也就是他所說 p 值最高，或最具統計顯著性、能以最高準確度預測利潤的特徵。

cues.en: So once again, you don't have to worry about this.
cues.zh: 因此，再次不用擔心。

cues.en: The class of (indistinct), you know this amazing data science library will take care of everything for you.
cues.zh: 這個很棒的 scikit-learn 類別，會替你處理模型的運算。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm glad I answered these two questions.
cues.zh: 很高興回答這兩個問題。

cues.en: You know, the purpose of building machinery models today is to be efficient because in your career, you know, I can't tell you how many times I had to test several machinery models
cues.zh: 如今建立模型的目的是有效率，因為工作中經常需要在同一份資料集上測試多種模型，

cues.en: on my dataset and select the best one.
cues.zh: 再選最好的。

cues.en: Well, you know if I had to deploy the backward elimination technique on my dataset, well, I would've lost a lot of time.
cues.zh: 如果每次都要手動做向後淘汰，就會耗費很多時間。

cues.en: And here we have a class that takes care of everything, you just have to deploy your class on your data set and then you will get an accuracy and you will compare that accuracy with the accuracies of other models.
cues.zh: 這個類別會替你處理所有事情。只要把類別套用到資料集，就能取得準確率，再和其他模型的準確率比較。

cues.en: And you know, that process is called model selection.
cues.zh: 這個過程叫模型選擇。

cues.en: That's what we actually cover in the part 10 of this course.
cues.zh: 課程第十部分會介紹。

cues.en: So really, I want you to be efficient with your implementations and your machine learning toolkit so that you can optimize your model selection process.
cues.zh: 希望你有效率地使用實作與工具箱，讓模型選擇流程更順暢。

cues.en: All right, so now that we said this, well, let's build together the Multiple Linear Regression model.
cues.zh: 現在說明完了，一起建立多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: And now actually, I have some good news because, you know, we're still doing linear regression.
cues.zh: 有個好消息，因為我們仍在做線性迴歸。

cues.en: And in the previous section we actually did simple linear regression, with which we therefore had one feature in our data set, and now we're doing multiple linear regression,
cues.zh: 上一章是只有一個特徵的簡單線性迴歸，現在是多元線性迴歸，

cues.en: which is exactly the same as simple linear regression except that we have several features.
cues.zh: 差別只是有多個特徵。

cues.en: So the good news is actually that the class that we're about to use to build and train this Multiple Linear Regression model is actually the exact same class as for the Simple Linear Regression model,
cues.zh: 所以建立與訓練模型的類別，其實和簡單線性迴歸完全一樣。

cues.en: it will just recognize that there are several features and therefore that we are doing multiple linear regression, but the rest will be exactly the same.
cues.zh: 它會辨認輸入有多個特徵，其餘過程相同。

cues.en: It will be trained to understand the correlations between all your features - actually, I can open it here - all your features and the profit, which is your dependent variable,
cues.zh: 模型會學習這裡各項特徵，和依變數 Profit 之間的關係。

cues.en: and then it will take care of the dummy variable trap and it will also take care of selecting the best features that are the most statistically significant.
cues.zh: 講者也認為這個實作會處理虛擬變數陷阱，以及最具統計顯著性的特徵選擇。
